description: Hard German retrieval golden set over the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, one doc per article/annex — build_corpus.py). Designed for the failure modes the base set saturates on: near-identical obligation articles as distractors (Anbieter/Betreiber/Einfuehrer), cross-reference multi-hop, vocabulary-mismatch paraphrases, and near-miss unanswerables (plausible but NOT in the AI Act). Labels verified against the split corpus 2026-06-12.
